title: Memo: Nscale CEO Josh Payne says it has "more than $100B in contracted revenue"; sources say it still plans to list by the end of 2026 at a $30B-$35B valuation (Kieran Smith/Financial Times)
summary: Kieran Smith / Financial Times: Memo: Nscale CEO Josh Payne says it has “more than $100B in contracted revenue”; sources say it still plans to list by the end of 2026 at a $30B-$35B valuation — Founder Josh Payne says demand remains ‘insatiable’ for the services of Nvidia-backed data centre group
contentText:
Kieran Smith / Financial Times :

Memo: Nscale CEO Josh Payne says it has “more than $100B in contracted revenue”; sources say it still plans to list by the end of 2026 at a $30B-$35B valuation   —  Founder Josh Payne says demand remains ‘insatiable’ for the services of Nvidia-backed data centre group
